observations.name: Published route and truthful graphics recovery
observations.outcome: HTTPS route opened after redirect; native controls loaded; WebGL2 unavailable was displayed and camera controls were disabled. No graphics success inferred.

observations.name: Reorder permission label
observations.outcome: v15 showed read-only beside enabled CEO reorder actions. Actual adjacent-order probes corrected the label; allowed was observed in v16 and v17.

observations.name: Visitor controls
observations.outcome: Visiting employee selection disabled Save name, Apply color and both reorder buttons.

observations.name: Donna scoped edit and literal text
observations.outcome: Donna Studio renamed Design to Design <QA>; revision 1, Saved and literal text were visible; focus returned to Save name.

observations.name: Donna attribution and undo
observations.outcome: History named Donna Studio and the field change; Undo restored Design with a new revision 2 event.

observations.name: Donna company-position boundary
observations.outcome: Company position opened with Move company disabled and an explicit missing-grant explanation.

observations.name: Local sub-Donna creation
observations.outcome: CEO created Design QA Donna; the UI selected the new actor at revision 5 and showed the explicit Design-and-children grant. The result said that no worker was started.

observations.name: Department scope boundary
observations.outcome: The sub-Donna could rename Design but selecting Engineering disabled its editing actions.

observations.name: Delegated ownership and immediate revocation
observations.outcome: Design QA Donna renamed its room to Design workshop at revision 6. CEO revoked that actor grant at revision 7; selecting the actor immediately disabled editing and showed no explicit grants.

observations.name: Combined persistence after reload
observations.outcome: After a full published-page reload, the local actor, Design workshop, revision 7 and revoked editing state remained visible.

observations.name: Current actor presentation
observations.outcome: v16 exposed a redundant Editing as CEO message after automatic sub-Donna selection. The final UI suppresses success status text in favor of the live selector and canvas control; both showed the selected actor consistently in v17.

observations.name: Owner undo after policy change
observations.outcome: CEO history showed revocation at revision 7 and the delegated rename at revision 6. Owner Undo restored Design and advanced to revision 8. Policy retention is additionally covered by pure and DOM tests; no separate native grant assertion was made after this undo.

observations.name: Keyboard and laptop popup layout
observations.outcome: Tab from Name focused Save name. At 1363 × 936, the Studio popup measured 420 × 680 and its internal body scrolled; document dimensions equaled viewport dimensions and window scroll remained 0,0.

observations.name: Native popup movement
observations.outcome: Header drag moved the Studio popup from 40,90 to 520,110, preserving its 420 × 680 dimensions, selected CEO and zero window scroll.

sourceVersions.scope: Native delegation/edit/history flows; two presentation corrections identified across v15/v16.
Final published source: persistence, revoked controls, owner undo, corrected labels, keyboard access, layout and popup drag.

limitations: No WebGL2 context was available in managed Chrome; shaders, rasterized appearance, 3D picking, rendered glyphs, shadows and GPU FPS remain unverified.
Native checks used synthetic local demo records, not real user grants, connected accounts or running agents.
No claim that all v16 native scenarios were rerun after the one-line v17 actor-status correction. The final complete 14-group DOM run covers the final UI hash.

The initial local-preview reload and its issue-report attempt were rejected by browser URL policy. No local retry or browser/GPU bypass was used. The independently published HTTPS route opened normally.
qaData: One locally saved Design QA Donna definition remains in the browser with its grant revoked; the original Design name was restored. No QA records were added to shipped seed data.
earlierCheckpoint: browser-receipt.json retains 20 observations for the older 287dfdf checkpoint only.
